text: 纳斯达克金龙中国指数收涨1.71%，报5613.68点，脱离上周五（美国非农日）收盘位5519.24点。 ETF中，中概互联网指数ETF（KWEB）收涨2.93%，中国科技指数ETF（CQQQ）收涨2.46%。 MSCI新兴市场ex中国ETF（EMXC）收涨1.44%，XtrackersHarvest中证50（ASHS）收涨0.66%，德银嘉实沪深300指数ETF（ASHR）收涨0.43%。
text_en: The Nasdaq Golden Dragon China Index closed up 1.71% at 5,613.68 points, moving away from Friday's (US nonfarm payrolls day) close of 5,519.24. Among ETFs, the KraneShares China Internet ETF (KWEB) closed up 2.93%, and the China Technology ETF (CQQQ) closed up 2.46%. The MSCI Emerging Markets ex-China ETF (EMXC) closed up 1.44%, the Xtrackers Harvest CSI 500 (ASHS) rose 0.66%, and the Deutsche X-trackers Harvest CSI 300 Index ETF (ASHR) rose 0.43%.
